problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate resources from a series of distribution hubs to a network of retail outlets, aiming to reduce the overall transfer expenditure.

The inventory available at each distribution hub (set H) is as follows:
*Hub H1 holds 100 units.
*Hub H2 holds 167 units.
*Hub H3 holds 77 units.
*Hub H4 holds 84 units.
*Hub H5 holds 127 units.
*Hub H6 holds 51 units.
*Hub H7 holds 151 units.
*Hub H8 holds 135 units.
*Hub H9 holds 147 units.

The required fulfillment at each retail outlet (set R) is detailed below:
*Outlet R1 requires 62 units.
*Outlet R2 requires 63 units.
*Outlet R3 requires 152 units.
*Outlet R4 requires 160 units.
*Outlet R5 requires 181 units.
*Outlet R6 requires 25 units.
*Outlet R7 requires 59 units.
*Outlet R8 requires 176 units.
*Outlet R9 requires 37 units.

The per-unit transfer cost from each hub to each outlet is provided in the following matrix:
| Source / Destination | R1 | R2 | R3 | R4 | R5 | R6 | R7 | R8 | R9 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| H1 | 11 | 6 | 13 | 11 | 10 | 16 | 19 | 8 | 11 |
| H2 | 13 | 9 | 13 | 12 | 4 | 19 | 7 | 19 | 18 |
| H3 | 6 | 18 | 1 | 15 | 7 | 15 | 10 | 3 | 14 |
| H4 | 16 | 5 | 10 | 8 | 9 | 5 | 14 | 13 | 3 |
| H5 | 15 | 20 | 16 | 19 | 13 | 18 | 17 | 14 | 18 |
| H6 | 2 | 12 | 18 | 20 | 3 | 4 | 8 | 12 | 6 |
| H7 | 20 | 2 | 19 | 13 | 11 | 14 | 4 | 1 | 4 |
| H8 | 9 | 8 | 17 | 17 | 18 | 19 | 19 | 8 | 15 |
| H9 | 12 | 13 | 15 | 19 | 17 | 5 | 12 | 1 | 16 |

Determine the optimal allocation of units to be transferred in order to minimize the cumulative expenditure.
